summary: Ultrapar Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its 2025 Form 20-F annual report with the SEC. This is a routine regulatory disclosure by a foreign private issuer, providing access to audited financial statements. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any event-driven or risk-arbitrage angle.
